Edge.description: A directed edge between two nodes.

branch.description: Which source-node outcome may activate this edge. Omitted means always.

condition.description: Optional guard expression. The edge is only taken when it evaluates truthy.

source_port.description: Optional named output port on the source node.

target_port.description: Optional named input port on the target node.

EdgeBranch.description: Selects which source-node outcome activates an edge.

oneOf.description: Activate on either success or failure.
Activate only after the source node succeeds.
Activate only after the source node fails. At least one failure edge handles the error, so an explicit recovery branch does not require `continue_on_error`.

Node.description: A node in the workflow graph.

condition.description:
Optional expression evaluated before this node is executed.

A false result skips the node and does not activate its outgoing branches. The expression can read the current run scope.

config.description: Node-type specific configuration. The shape depends on `type`; the published schema carries one branch per installed node type.

continue_on_error.description: Whether execution continues through this node's eligible outgoing branches after all retry attempts fail. An explicit `branch: failure` edge can handle the error without this escape hatch. Policy denials and validation errors never use either mechanism.

delay_after_ms.description: Delay after successful execution, before outgoing branches activate.

delay_before_ms.description: Delay before the executor is invoked, in milliseconds.

enabled.description: Whether this node participates in execution. Disabled nodes are treated as transparent pass-throughs, so their outgoing branches remain usable.

id.description: Unique, stable identifier within the workflow.

result_port.description: Output port captured by `result_var`. When omitted, `out` or the first declared runtime output is used.

result_var.description: Optional run-scope variable that receives one of this node's outputs.

retry.description: Number of additional attempts after the first failed execution.

retry_delay_ms.description: Delay between failed attempts, in milliseconds.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time an executor may spend on one attempt, in milliseconds.

type.description: Installed node type. The editor completes this from the descriptors the runtime published.

expression.description: Arithmetic and comparison expression evaluated against the run scope. Supports `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `%`, `^`, comparisons and `&&`/`||`.
expression.title: Expression

output_var.description: Variable the result is published under.
output_var.title: Output variable

code.description: Process exit code reported by the runtime when the workflow finishes.
code.title: Exit code

$schema.description:
Optional `$schema` reference to the JSON Schema this document follows.

Editors resolve it to complete node types, configuration keys, defaults and enums — see [`crate::workflow_schema_for`]. The field is part of the document and survives every round-trip (migration, load, save), so a workflow keeps its content hints wherever it is opened.
